project.name: The Harbour Ledger
project.description: City news platform where writers draft stories across sections, editors review and publish them, and readers browse, bookmark, follow sections, and comment.

direction.palette: Paper warm white + ink neutral + minimal accent + tag colors

app.name: The Harbour Ledger
app.tagline: A trusted city news daily covering City, Business, Culture, and Sport

help.editorFeedback: Notes and required revisions provided by the editor
help.isLeadStory: Highlight this article as the front-page lead story
help.scheduledFor: Future time when the article will automatically or manually be released

help.body: Join the discussion on this story

help.articleId: The published article saved to your reading list

help.section: Follow sections you care about to receive curated updates

looks.reason: Clean Swiss grid emphasizes journalistic objectivity, legibility, and high-density content hierarchy.

requested.words: editorial and trustworthy, a classic serif for headlines, off-white paper and a navy accent

design.reason: Editorial news publication emphasizing curated front-page reading, section-based discovery, and structured editorial workflows.
replaced: Follow: title 'section' left out (a enum field is not a name)
look 'minimal' replaced by 'soft': three quiet looks offer no choice

tours.name: Publish Article
tours.outcome: An article is reviewed and published for public readership

steps.title: Draft article in section (the article becomes draft). Rule: Section must be City, Business, Culture, or Sport
Submit draft for review (the article becomes submitted). Rule: Headline, section, and body cannot be empty
Review submitted draft (the article becomes under_review). Rule: Must verify factual integrity and editorial tone
Publish article (the article becomes published). Rule: Only submitted or reviewed drafts can be published

tours.name: Read and Comment on Article
tours.outcome: A reader reads a story and adds their perspective to the article discussion

steps.title: View front page and select article. Rule: Only published articles are visible
Post comment on article (the comment becomes posted). Rule: Comments can only be posted on published articles

tours.name: Bookmark Article and Follow Section
tours.outcome: Articles are saved for later reading and sections are followed for curated discovery

steps.title: Bookmark article to read later (the bookmark becomes bookmarked). Rule: Only published articles can be bookmarked
Follow section (the follow becomes active). Rule: Section must be an existing active section
